page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highcpu-16 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4n server family. It is equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and paired with 32.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a resource density of exactly 2.0 GB of RAM per core, prioritizing raw processing power over memory capacity.

This instance does not include any local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage operations must utilize network-attached block storage. Additionally, the configuration provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires external routing or NAT gateways for public internet access.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and high vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is designed for compute-bound workloads. It is well-suited for tasks such as batch processing, web serving, and distributed computational workloads that do not demand large memory footprints or local disk performance.
